text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Qi... resonates with one another.
And—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Dreams are "synergy"—they strengthen one another.
Even if each and every one takes a different form.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(And if I truly wish for someone's happiness
through feng shui—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(She wishes for that with all her heart.
For the happiness of the people from her hometown.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (Yes, the Hokko Tarumae I know is—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Even if I die—I will never give up on my hometown!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...
Hokko Tarumae reappeared on the racetrack for the first time in seven months. And when she did...

She appeared to be trembling faintly.
Even so—she had returned to this place.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I was thinking... that I have to go back.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I knew I had to go back, the whole time.
And yet my legs just wouldn't move...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: But watching Rickey covered in mud...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I just felt like I couldn't lose.
And so...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I wanted to go back! No matter what!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'm the only one
who can bring happiness to the folks back home. And...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Even if we get beaten black and blue, standing back up without losing heart is the Tomakomai spirit! That's why!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you I can do it once more!
That's right, I am Tomakomai's very own—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The indomitable fairy, Hokko Tarumae!!
Once more, for the sake of those she holds dear!!

Hokko Tarumae... has finally returned.
With this, the Twinkle Series dirt races will regain their former heat—no, become even hotter than before.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae, it's been a while, so maybe you're not at your absolute best right now, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I won't hold back♪ Feel my burning passion!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

And so—their autumn was set into motion.
From Tohoku, where the autumn leaves were still faintly colored.
